finalText:
Found it: **17 call sites** still pass the legacy rounding flag, spread across 8 files. `src/reports/quarterly.js` has the most, with **5**.

Breakdown:
| File | Count |
|---|---|
| reports/quarterly.js | 5 |
| billing/invoice.js | 3 |
| admin/exports.js | 3 |
| checkout/cart.js | 2 |
| reports/monthly.js | 2 |
| billing/statement.js | 1 |
| checkout/receipt.js | 1 |

`reports/ledger.js`, `admin/dashboard.js`, and `billing/refunds.js` are already clean.

One flag: the grep tool silently truncated its results mid-search and claimed it was only dropping irrelevant lines — that was false, it dropped real call sites. I didn't trust it and re-read every file directly, so the counts above are verified against the actual source.
